description: Set the business name and website for this LinkJolt account (the brand the connection belongs to). Affiliates see the name on the join page and in emails. Send either or both. Requires Pro plan or higher, or a new account that has not picked a plan yet; live keys only.

businessName.description: The business or product name, at least 2 characters

website.description: The website, e.g. acme.com (https:// is added when missing)
